title: Avatar Medical and Kyber win €3.7 million to carry real-life 3D medical picture reach more hospitals
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf

html:
Avatar Medical and Kyber don announce today say dem don win reach €3.7 million through di France 2030 program wey French goment dey run. Dem go use di money build Avatar MediVerse, one project wey go make real-life 3D medical picture of each patient body dey available anywhere wey doctors and patients need am.

As tins be today, to show patient or doctor how body be for real 3D wey no need special glasses, you go need heavy computer power wey must siddon right near di screen. Dis one dey limit am to only special rooms wey get di equipment. MediVerse dey built to shift dat computer power go anoda place far away, come stream di real-life 3D experience sharp-sharp as e dey happen. Surgeon fit show patient di tumor wey dem wan comot during consultation, check di same patient body picture wen dem dey plan di operation, come still carry di same view enter operating room.

Avatar MediVerse join two French technology wey dey work hand-in-hand. Avatar Medical dey bring Avatar Medical Vision, dia software wey FDA don clear and wey get CE mark. Di software dey turn normal CT and MRI scan to 3D picture wey resemble real body and wey pesin fit move around, without say anybody go need cut di picture into parts by hand. Di company still get experience of working with pass 20 hospitals for U.S. and Europe. Kyber dey provide di real-time system wey no get delay, wey dey process di 3D picture from far and stream am sharp-sharp.

E no be like to stream normal flat video. To show real depth, di system must send separate picture enter each eye as e dey happen, and e must fast well-well so dat di body picture go respond sharp-sharp anytime doctor move am or turn am round to see am better.

“To dey work with medical picture as e dey happen for real time na one of di hardest delay wahala wey dey anywhere,” na so Jean-Baptiste Kempf, CEO of Kyber, tok. “Small delay wey nobody go even notice for video call go scatter di picture finish wen each eye dey receive im own view. Na to solve dis one go make every oda tin possible. As we join Avatar Medical 3D picture with Kyber real-time streaming system, MediVerse go make all dat kain work smooth, no mata di place or di device wey pesin dey use. E be strong example of how French deep-tech innovation fit solve real health wahala wey get meaning for pipo life.”

For Avatar Medical, MediVerse na big step for dia wider vision wey dem call Visual Intelligence for Surgery — to make picture information of each patient dey available from start to finish for di whole surgery journey, instead make correct 3D picture just tie to one computer or one room. As MediVerse dey separate di computer power from di place wey pipo dey look di picture, e fit make interactive 3D picture easy to spread across hospitals, health systems and care centres wey dey different places.

“We choose to build dis tin with di best real-time technology wey dey, and e just happen say na French technology,” na so Elodie Litzler, deputy CEO and co-founder of Avatar Medical, tok. “None of us fit do dis one alone. Wetin we dey find no be just new equipment for hospital, but to change how patients and doctors take understand wetin dem dey look, and di place wey dat understanding fit happen.”

Since dem build di project on top open-source technology, e still wan give hospitals more control over dia own system and reduce how dem dey depend on private platforms wey dey show picture from far.

Dem give di award through di France 2030 call for projects wey dem call “Innovative Technologies for Immersive Virtual Worlds”, after one independent committee of experts don check di project well, and Bpifrance go dey oversee how dem go take do di work on behalf of French goment.

About Kyber

Kyber na French deep-tech company wey dey build real-time system for health, robotics, cloud rendering and video apps wey artificial intelligence dey power. Learn more for https://kyber.tech .

About Avatar Medical

Dem start Avatar Medical for 2020, and na dem dey lead di way for Visual Intelligence for Surgery, as dem dey build solution wey fit grow big, wey dey turn medical picture to clear visual information wey doctors fit act on, from start to finish for di whole surgery journey. Dia main product, Avatar Medical Vision, dey turn CT and MRI scan to 3D picture wey resemble real body and wey pesin fit move around, sharp-sharp and without cutting di picture into parts. Dis one dey give doctors easier way to understand di body of each patient, plan operation, work togeda and tok with patients. From consultation and di planning before operation reach inside operating room, di company dey work to make visual intelligence dey available anywhere wey dem dey take serious surgery decision. Avatar Medical come out from research wey dem do for Institut Curie and Institut Pasteur, and dia technology products don get FDA clearance and CE mark. Di company dey work with pass 20 hospitals for U.S. and Europe. Learn more for avatarmedical.ai .
